paragraphs: Rav Yehudah, brother of Rav Kahana.
Chullin 111b reads, “Rav Kahana, brother of Rav Yehudah, sat before Rav Huna.” The Rosh and Dikdukei Soferim read, “Rav Kahana sat behind Rav Yehudah.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The consulted Chullin paragraph explicitly names Rav Huna. The alternative “behind Rav Yehudah” is Hyman’s report of the Rosh and Dikdukei Soferim, distinct from the brother reading.

The checked Chullin 111b paragraph explicitly calls Rav Kahana the brother of Rav Yehudah and places him before Rav Huna. “Behind Rav Yehudah” remains Hyman’s report of the Rosh and Dikdukei Soferim; those apparatus witnesses have not been freshly collated. The two readings do not automatically establish a brother relation under the alternative reading.
